title: Graph normalization of the proper/etale interchange
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and use ordinary small-etale module sheaves and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let f′:X′→Y′ be separated finite type, v:Y′→Y separated etale finite type, with compactifications of f′, v and f′v, between Noetherian schemes. Fix c′=(j′,p′), a compactification of f′. Let Z be Noetherian, p:Z→Y proper, b:c′.Z→Z separated etale, and (b,p′,p,v) Cartesian. Let r:X′→Z be separated etale quasi-compact with r=j′b, let e compactify r, and supply a compactification of rp. Use S for derived sum extension, J′ for derived open extension, P=Rp_* and Q=Rp′_*. Let sumEx:U_p′ S_b→S_v U_p be the inverse mate of the exact inverse-image square, and assume it is invertible. Let gam:Q S_v→S_b P be the mate of inverse sumEx under U_p′ adjoint Q and U_p adjoint P. Let s:J′S_b→S_r be the conjugate of U_r→U_b U_j′. Let d_v:F_v→S_v be the canonical graph comparison, and rho:F_f′S_v→F_rp be F_f′ of d_v inverse, the specified compact-support compositor, and congruence f′v=rp. Let k:S_rP→F_rp be inverse canonical graph comparison for e, associator, proper direct-image composition and the model-to-chosen comparison for e.postcomp p. Then for every derived M on X′, S_v(t_c′.hom at M), followed by rho.hom at M equals gam at J′M, followed by P(s.hom at M), followed by k.hom at M. There is no second upper open-square comparison a and no etale-first compact-support composition in this assertion.

proof.text: Normalize the open/proper factorization c′=(j′,q) of f′ and proper postcomposition of e using the every-triangle compositor equation and the identity open/proper unit laws. These normalizations are proved in Lean.

Separate the two geometric comparisons: the proper Cartesian square (b,q,p,v) identifies its transported compact-support compositor with gam; independently, graph normalization for an open immersion followed by an etale map identifies the compositor for j′b with the conjugate s. Neither comparison contains both pieces of the tower.

Use associativity of the chosen compact-support compositor and congruence for qv=bp to identify the two pastings of the square. Apply the proved abstract naturality/cancellation lemma to the chosen open, proper and graph isomorphisms. Cancel their inverse components and use proper postcomposition to obtain exactly k at e.postcomp p. This is a complete categorical composition proof; the original statement is unchanged.

theorem etaleGraph_proper_tower
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X' Y' Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X'] [IsNoetherian Y'] [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian Z]
    {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {v : Y' ⟶ Y}
    [IsSeparated f'] [LocallyOfFiniteType f'] [QuasiCompact f']
    [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [QuasiCompact v]
    [HasCompactification f'] [HasCompactification v]
    [HasCompactification (f' ≫ v)] [QuasiCompact (f' ≫ v)]
    (c' : Compactification f') (p : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper p]
    (b : c'.Z ⟶ Z) [Etale b] [IsSeparated b]
    (psq : IsPullback b c'.g p v)
    (r : X' ⟶ Z) [Etale r] [IsSeparated r] [QuasiCompact r]
    (hr : r = c'.i ≫ b) (e : Compactification r)
    [HasCompactification (r ≫ p)]
    [IsIso (((mateEquiv
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance)
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b inferInstance)).symm
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (exactDerivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        psq.toCommSq).hom)).natTrans)]
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X') :
    let ba := derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b inferInstance
    let j'a := derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.i
    let s := (conjugateIsoEquiv
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r inferInstance)
      (j'a.comp ba)).symm
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
        (upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.i b r hr) ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _)
    let sumEx := ((mateEquiv
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance)
      ba).symm (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
        (exactDerivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) psq.toCommSq).hom)).natTrans
    let gam := (mateEquiv
      (mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.g)
      (mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p)
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (inv sumEx))).natTrans
    let dv := (rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A
      (HasCompactification.compactification v)).symm ≪≫
      canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison A v (HasCompactification.compactification v)
    let w : f' ≫ v = r ≫ p :=
      (congrArg (fun h : X' ⟶ Y' ↦ h ≫ v) c'.comm).trans
        ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
          ((congrArg (fun h ↦ c'.i ≫ h) psq.w.symm).trans
            ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun h ↦ h ≫ p) hr.symm))))
    let rho := Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f') dv.symm ≪≫
      unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A f' v ≪≫ unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCongr A w
    let k := Functor.isoWhiskerRight
      (canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison A r e).symm
      (rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p) ≪≫
      Functor.associator _ _ _ ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e.i).mapDerivedCategory
        (rightDerivedLowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e.g p) ≪≫
      rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A (e.postcomp p)
    (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A c').hom.app M) ≫ rho.hom.app M =
      gam.app
        ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c'.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).map (s.hom.app M) ≫ k.hom.app M
